snippet.title: PUBG DED.NET - Fresh Meat Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
PUBG DED.NET is a new first-person shooter from Krafton where you trade flesh for power. In this dog eat dog world, you'll need every advantage to survive and kill the competition. Join the closed beta, coming soon to Xbox Series X/S.
